description_en: Imports a portable template in JSON format and creates a new template, regardless of whether a template with the same name exists
description_zh: 有效成员导入可移植模板 JSON 并创建新模板；无论名称是否相同都新建
name: ImportWorkflowTemplate

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The portable template in JSON format. The stepId and sortOrder fields can be omitted
parameters.help_zh: 可移植模板 JSON（stepId/sortOrder 可省略）
parameters.name: template

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

createdByUserId.description_en: The user ID of the creator

description.example: 处理客户投诉的标准流程

edges.description_en: The node dependency edges. Each item contains from and to fields that reference stable step IDs. An explicit empty array indicates no dependencies
edges.description_zh: 节点依赖边；每项包含from/to，引用稳定stepId；显式空数组表示没有依赖

items.description_en: A node dependency edge. The from field is the step ID of the predecessor node, and the to field is the step ID of the successor node
items.description_zh: 一条节点依赖边，from为前置节点stepId，to为后置节点stepId

effectiveVersion.description_en: The current effective version number of the template. An empty value indicates that only a draft exists and it cannot be used for work items. The import operation always creates a v1 draft, so this field is empty
effectiveVersion.description_zh: 模板当前生效版本号；为空表示仅有草稿、不可用于工作项（导入固定创建 v1 草稿，本字段为空）

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

gmtModified.description_en: The modification time in ISO 8601 format

layout.description_en: The optional canvas layout, indexed by step ID. This only affects the display and does not determine dependencies
layout.description_zh: 可选画布布局，按stepId索引；只影响展示，不决定依赖

schemaVersion.description_en: The schema version of the template. The current value is 2, which is independent of the business version vN
schemaVersion.description_zh: 模板结构版本，当前为2，与业务版本vN独立

ownerAgentName.description_en: The name of the digital worker executor. This can be empty when importing a draft, but is required when an AGENT submits the task. The field name is retained for backward compatibility, and its meaning aligns with the current semantics of executor and person in charge
ownerAgentName.description_zh: 数字员工执行人名称；导入草稿可为空，AGENT 提交时必填；字段名保留用于兼容，含义按当前执行人与负责人语义

ownerType.description_en: The type of the executor. Valid values: MEMBER (workspace member) and AGENT (digital worker). The field name is retained for backward compatibility, and its meaning aligns with the current semantics of executor and person in charge
ownerType.description_zh: 执行人类型：MEMBER 空间成员 / AGENT 数字员工；字段名保留用于兼容，含义按当前执行人与负责人语义

ownerUserId.description_en: The user ID of the member executor. This can be empty when importing a draft, but is required when a MEMBER submits the task. The field name is retained for backward compatibility, and its meaning aligns with the current semantics of executor and person in charge
ownerUserId.description_zh: 成员执行人用户ID；导入草稿可为空，MEMBER 提交时必填；字段名保留用于兼容，含义按当前执行人与负责人语义

reviewOutput.description_en: Specifies whether to manually review the output. Default value: false. This feature can only be enabled for digital workers, and review tasks are automatically sent to the persons in charge
reviewOutput.description_zh: 是否人工审核产出物，默认关闭；仅数字员工可开启，审核待办自动发负责人

reviewerUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs for the persons in charge. Only members are supported. Persons in charge can be configured when the task is executed by either a member or a digital worker. The field name is retained for backward compatibility, and its meaning aligns with the current semantics of executor and person in charge
reviewerUserIds.description_zh: 负责人用户ID列表；仅支持成员；成员或数字员工执行时均可配置负责人；字段名保留用于兼容，含义按当前执行人与负责人语义

items.description_en: The list of user IDs for the persons in charge. Only members are supported. Persons in charge can be configured when the task is executed by either a member or a digital worker. The field name is retained for backward compatibility, and its meaning aligns with the current semantics of executor and person in charge
items.description_zh: 负责人用户ID列表；仅支持成员；成员或数字员工执行时均可配置负责人；字段名保留用于兼容，含义按当前执行人与负责人语义

specification.example: 收集客户信息，交给负责人审核

specificationJson.description_en: The ordered array of fragments. Supports text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. Preserves reference identities and order
specificationJson.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

items.description_en: The ordered array of fragments. Supports text, mention, skill, app, files, and web_search. Preserves reference identities and order
items.description_zh: 有序片段数组，支持text/mention/skill/app/files/web_search；保留引用身份和顺序

version.description_en: The version number generated by this import
version.description_zh: 本次导入生成的版本号

versionStatus.description_en: The version status. Valid values: DRAFT (draft) and SUBMITTED (submitted). The status is fixed to DRAFT for imports
versionStatus.description_zh: 版本状态：DRAFT 草稿 / SUBMITTED 已提交；导入固定为 DRAFT
